The principle is fixed: every action is measured against your policy before it happens — if it is within bounds it is carried out; if not, it is stopped and placed with you.

site.modul.m1.tekst: Defines what the agents are actually allowed to do.
site.modul.m10.tekst: Verifies that the backup can actually be restored, and records every measurement as a row. Fewer than ten tables or a dump under 1 KiB is not a weak verification — it is a sign the restore hit the wrong database, and it is rejected.
site.modul.m11.tekst: Runs the platform's probes and separates «red» from «not set up here» — the latter is never alerted on. The self-test cannot report its own death, so a missed run is reported by the notification sender.
site.modul.m12.tekst: The access register: who has which access to what, with owner and legal basis. v1 provisions nothing — it makes discrepancies visible, because seeing the truth is the precondition for daring to change it.
site.modul.m13.tekst: The reconciliation register: bank entries against vouchers, and the unmatched entries with their age. v1 posts nothing — a posting writes to the ledger, and a ledger changed by something nobody read is not a ledger.
site.modul.m14.tekst: Checks on incoming invoices: duplicates, VAT against the base, and supplier against the register — with the hit rate measured. v1 books nothing and attests nothing; an attestation is what lets an automatic booking through.
site.modul.m15.tekst: The cash path thirteen weeks out, with an interval rather than a single number — and every forecast measured against what actually happened. v1 cancels nothing and pays nothing: a cost measure is a proposal, and carrying it out goes through the module that owns it.
site.modul.m16.tekst: Key figures computed from actual decisions — a pure read surface, nothing smoothed or projected.
site.modul.m17.tekst: The enquiry register: what someone asked, how it was classified, and a draft reply. v1 sends nothing — a reply to a customer is a statement on the company's behalf, and a person should stand behind it.
site.modul.m18.tekst: The onboarding register: which steps a new customer run consists of, who owns each of them, and where the run actually stands. v1 provisions nothing — a completed run has to be measurable first.
site.modul.m19.tekst: The address as it was given, and how a person checked it. v1 looks nothing up externally: a lookup is the customer's address leaving the building.
site.modul.m2.tekst: Makes every automated action traceable and reviewable.
site.modul.m20.tekst: Drafts website content and newsletters. The module publishes nothing itself: a draft becomes ready, and activation is a person's — with preview and rollback. No product claim without a source to look up.
site.modul.m21.tekst: An obligations register with alerts well ahead of every deadline. Each obligation has an owner, and a deadline is closed by a receipt or a written status — never by time simply passing it.
site.modul.m22.tekst: Licences and subscriptions with owner, cost and renewal date — and alerts well before expiry. Nothing is cancelled automatically: a licence removed in error locks someone out of their job.
site.modul.m23.tekst: The receivables register with ageing, and overdue receivables as findings. v1 sends no reminder and no offer — a reminder sent to the wrong customer cannot be taken back.
site.modul.m24.tekst: The supplier agreements and delivery measured against them: SLA breaches and price rises as findings. v1 pays nothing and sets no price — an outgoing payment is impossible to undo.
site.modul.m25.tekst: The project, the contract's milestones and spend against budget. v1 invoices nothing — an invoice for a milestone nobody documented is money claimed for work that may not have happened.
site.modul.m26.tekst: The company's own prices and standard clauses, versioned, so a quote given yesterday can be traced to the price that applied then. v1 sets no price and generates no quote — every price is written by a person.
site.modul.m27.tekst: Stock as the sum of its movements, and the reorder point as a finding. v1 orders nothing and forecasts nothing — an automatic purchase order is money out the door on a number nobody measured.
site.modul.m28.tekst: Plans shipments against registered parcels and validated addresses. The module books no transport and rebooks nothing — the proposal carries its own reasoning. The hazard class is given by a human, never inferred from a product description.
site.modul.m29.tekst: Correlates identity, endpoint, network and application events, and scores them with explainable rules. The module intervenes in nothing: it isolates no account and rotates no secret — an intervention without a playbook becomes a finding, and no door accepts a command string.
site.modul.m3.tekst: Measures data quality instead of assuming it: empty fields, format deviations and duplicate keys are profiled and reported with numbers. v1 corrects nothing and blocks no order — it makes quality visible, so acting on it becomes a deliberate decision.
site.modul.m30.tekst: Access and erasure requests with deadline, owner and a written response. A request is closed by the answer, never by the deadline passing — a missed access request is a breach of law, not a delay.
site.modul.m31.tekst: Golden-set evaluation of model-based modules: every model switch is measured against a hash-pinned example set, and the release gate only admits a passing run against the current requirement.
site.modul.m32.tekst: Determines jurisdiction, rate and rule version per transaction. The module files nothing. A country without a complete country package has no row, and without a row there is no rate — an uncertain jurisdiction stops the transaction rather than guessing.
site.modul.m33.tekst: Forecasts with measurable uncertainty, backtested against a naive baseline. A model that cannot beat «same as last week» carries authority it has not earned. Forecasts are not facts, and no personnel decision rests on them.
site.modul.m34.tekst: The control register: which requirement each control covers, who owns it, and when it was last verified. The difference between “we do this” and “we can show we did this” is the only one that counts in an audit.
site.modul.m35.tekst: Keeps preparedness measured rather than assumed: a service map with recovery targets, confirmed emergency contacts, an append-only incident log — and an exercise that reads the actual backup evidence and reports red when it is missing.
site.modul.m36.tekst: Ranks improvements across the modules without touching their boundaries. Every proposal carries whether its basis is correlation, experiment or rule — because correlation presented as cause is the error that looks most like insight.
site.modul.m37.tekst: Collects everything stopped by policy into one controlled queue.
site.modul.m38.tekst: Distributes work, capacity and model choice per tenant and flow.
site.modul.m39.tekst: Hours measured against the work plan, with overtime as a finding. v1 pays nothing and produces no payroll file — an error there hits someone who counted on the amount.
site.modul.m4.tekst: The house's retention ledger: every store names its deadline and its reaper, holdings are measured, and a store without a written verdict becomes a finding. The module deletes nothing — it makes the difference between “deliberately without a deadline” and “forgotten” readable.
site.modul.m40.tekst: Runs onboarding journeys, pulse surveys and documents from locked templates. The module decides nothing about a person: no decision with legal effect, no individual profile, no productivity score. Pulse responses carry no personal key at all.
site.modul.m41.tekst: Which payment status applied when, and where it came from. v1 refunds nothing and authorises no payment — a refund is money out the door, and it is irreversible.
site.modul.m42.tekst: Which account number was given, by whom, when — and how a person verified it. An account change on a supplier we pay becomes a finding. v1 blocks no payment: a guard that blocks wrongly is its own harm.
site.modul.m43.tekst: Gathers telephony, queueing and call analysis into one channel. The agent always identifies itself as automated, enters no agreement and makes no financial promises. Recording and transcription require legal basis and notification — the same register as the meeting module.
site.modul.m44.tekst: The campaign, the recipients and the consent, with the frequency cap measured. v1 sends nothing: an e-mail cannot be recalled, and one too many is a complaint.
site.modul.m45.tekst: Gathers ESG data and computes emissions for audit-ready reporting. The module submits no report: submission is a person's. Every figure carries a source and a factor version, estimates are marked as estimates, and the standard version is locked per reporting period.
site.modul.m46.tekst: The notice, the deadline and which qualification requirements are covered. v1 submits no bid: a submitted bid is binding, and an uncovered requirement becomes a finding — never a filled-in guess.
site.modul.m47.tekst: The obligation, its legal basis and its deadline. v1 files nothing — but here absence is not enough: a deadline that passes unseen is exactly the harm the module exists to prevent, so a silent filing agent is worse than none.
site.modul.m48.tekst: The counterparty, the credit policy and the proposal — with purpose and legal basis on every lookup. v1 sets no credit limit and rejects no one: a limit the module set itself would become the receivables agent's ground truth without a person ever looking at it.
site.modul.m49.tekst: The check against the sanctions lists, with list version and match basis on every hit. v1 does not block: name similarity cannot be dismissed mechanically, and automatic blocking would have stopped lawful trade before anyone measured how often it is wrong.
site.modul.m5.tekst: Versioned document templates with required fields and locked clauses. Facts come from source fields and are never invented: a field without backing in the input is marked missing rather than filled with something that merely looks right.
site.modul.m50.tekst: The journal entry, the case, and the purpose it was registered for. v1 fetches nothing itself: a fact being public does not make it free to collect and combine, and «we found it online» is not a legal basis.
site.modul.m51.tekst: The scheme, its requirements and what our own figures give. v1 submits no application: a wrong figure in a submitted application is an incorrect statement to the authorities, so every amount is traced to its source entry.
site.modul.m52.tekst: The proposed HS code, with the nomenclature version and what the proposal rests on. v1 declares nothing: an HS code is a legal claim about what the goods are, the wrong code brings a fine, and a proposal without a basis manufactures false confidence.
site.modul.m53.tekst: The incident, the measure taken, and the retention basis. An anonymous report is its own state rather than an empty name field: a field that can be filled gets filled, and whistleblower protection that leaks identity is worthless.
site.modul.m54.tekst: The invoice's FORM against the standard, with the schema version on every validation. v1 sends no corrected invoice: an invoice sent twice is a double claim for payment, and a defect found against an expired schema version is a stale verdict that looks well-formed.
site.modul.m55.tekst: The finding, documented with URL, timestamp and a preserved copy. v1 sends no legal claim: a claim based on an automatic finding is an accusation against a named party, and a finding nobody can prove is worse than no finding.
site.modul.m56.tekst: Checks websites you have confirmed that you control, and stores the report as evidence.
site.modul.m57.tekst: Reads and ranks up to 5,000 applications blind against the role's requirements — a human decides who moves on, and nothing is sent without a signature.
site.modul.m6.tekst: Reads and prioritises your inbox — classification, drafts and follow-up suggestions; nothing is sent automatically.
site.modul.m7.tekst: Gathers meeting preparation, minutes and actions. The module makes no decision — it writes down the one people made, and marks what it is unsure of as unconfirmed. Recording never starts without legal basis and notification.
site.modul.m8.tekst: Lets candidates pick their own interview time — no login, no email back-and-forth.
site.modul.m9.tekst: Company terms with owner, source and validity date — and full-text search across them. A term without a source cannot be registered, and a term past its validity date becomes a finding rather than a quietly stale truth.

site.problem.etterpa_tekst: The mistake surfaces at month-end, not as it happens. By then it has already been carried out.
site.problem.manuelt_tekst: Limits and authority live in heads, spreadsheets and threads. Nobody can say for certain what applies today.
site.problem.spredt_tekst: Ask why a payment went through, and you assemble the answer from accounting, the bank, email and a note.

site.problem_tekst: Most tools can perform the task. What they cannot do is show that it was allowed — and stop when it wasn't.
site.security.tekst: Authority, attestation and audit trails are part of the workflow itself. When a condition is missing, the action stops and explains what needs to be resolved.

site.svar.data_sv: With us, encrypted, with access control per business: no sharing between customers, no use for anything you have not agreed to. Production gets its own machine, set up before the first customer. Today only staging exists, and it holds synthetic test data — never customer data.
site.svar.feil_sp: What happens when it is unsure?
site.svar.feil_sv: It stops. Doubt is treated as refusal, not as a probable yes, and the case goes to the queue with what was missing.
site.svar.hvem_sv: Businesses that already have rules for who may approve what, and want the system to enforce them rather than hope for them.
site.svar.kontroll_sp: What stops the agent doing something stupid?
site.svar.kontroll_sv: Your policy, enforced before the action. If a condition is missing, the action is not carried out — it stops and comes to you. A person can release that case, but only what your policy has made approvable in advance: the role the policy requires, the ceiling the policy sets, and exactly the condition that stopped it. Everything else stands, and the approval is logged. No button grants itself authority.
site.svar.start_sv: With one area and tight limits. You see what the agent actually does before you widen its authority — and it can be narrowed again at any time.
site.svar_tittel: What you'd ask in a meeting

site.tilbud.kapasitet.tekst: Work distribution and model choice per area, so volume never comes at the cost of control.
site.tilbud.spor.tekst: Every decision is traceable afterwards: what was done, why, against which policy version. Without digging through logs.
site.tilbud.unntak.tekst: Anything that cannot be done inside the limits lands in one queue with its reasoning — not in an inbox. You decide, the agent completes.
site.tilbud_note: Start with one area. Widen it once you see what it does.
site.tilbud_tittel: An agent that does the work, inside your limits

ui.adresse.ingen_krav: No validation requirements have been set.
ui.adresse.krav.caption: The tenant's own validation requirements
ui.adresse.krav.gyldig_hjelp: How long an approved check stays valid. A check from last year says nothing about where the customer lives today.
ui.adresse.krav.metoder_hjelp: At least one must be selected. A shop sending e-books and one sending refrigerators do not carry the same risk — which is why the requirement is yours, not ours.
ui.adresse.krav.ukontrollert_hjelp: How long an address may stay unchecked before it becomes a finding.
ui.adresse.liste.caption: Recipients with current address and latest check
ui.adresse.liste.ingen: No recipients have been registered yet.
ui.adresse.oversikt.hvorfor: This module looks nothing up. Querying an address register would send the customer's name and address out of the house — and a match in a register does not say the parcel reaches the person it is for. What is recorded here is the address as it was given, and how a person checked it.
ui.adresse.sammendrag: {aktive} active recipients, {medadresse} with an address, {kontrollerte} checked. {funn} open findings.
ui.adresse.skjema.aktiv_hjelp: A deactivated recipient accepts no new addresses, and the open findings are closed. The history remains.
ui.adresse.skjema.aktiv_ok: The recipient's status has been changed.
ui.adresse.skjema.begrunnelse_hjelp: Required when the outcome is not approved. A rejection must be reviewable by whoever later wonders why the goods were not sent.
ui.adresse.skjema.gjelder_fra_hjelp: The date the address took effect. It cannot lie in the future.
ui.adresse.skjema.kilde_hjelp: Where the address came from. An address the customer gave and one you typed in are not the same basis.
ui.adresse.skjema.kontrollor_hjelp: The person who actually made the judgement. Without who and how, “validated” is a claim.
ui.adresse.skjema.land_hjelp: Two-letter country code, for example NO. The code is not checked against any register.
ui.adresse.skjema.linje1_hjelp: Enter the address exactly as it was given. Nothing is corrected or expanded — the original is the only thing that can explain a misdelivery afterwards.
ui.adresse.skjema.metode_hjelp: How the address was checked. None of the methods is a lookup — the module asks no one outside the house.
ui.adresse.skjema.ref_hjelp: Your own customer, order or recipient reference. It must be unique.
ui.adresse.skjema.utfall_hjelp: “Could not be checked” is an answer, not a rejection: the address still counts as unchecked.
ui.adresse.undertittel: The address as it was given, and who checked it how
ui.anbud.feil.generell: Something went wrong. Please try again.
ui.anbud.feil.tilstand: The action is not legal now — for example an expired source, a requirement from another tender, or a draft already marked ready.
ui.anbud.feil.udekket_absolutt: The draft cannot be marked ready: an absolute requirement is uncovered.
ui.anbud.funn.notat_hjelp: At least four characters. An uncovered absolute requirement cannot be closed away.
ui.anbud.ingen_profil: No search profile set — NACE, geography and value limits are the tenant's.
ui.anbud.kilde.gyldig_hjelp: Optional. Without it, validity is measured from the search profile's window.
ui.anbud.kilde.hvorfor: Every fact in a draft points at one of these. The module cannot write a claim without a source.
ui.anbud.kilde.sum_hjelp: 64 hexadecimal characters. Without it nobody can show that it was exactly this version that was quoted.
ui.anbud.klart_hjelp: «Ready for review» submits nothing. It is a state on our side.
ui.anbud.krav.absolutt_hjelp: An absolute requirement without documentation leads to REJECTION. A weighted one costs points.
ui.anbud.krav.nummer_hjelp: As stated in the tender documents.
ui.anbud.ny.frist_hjelp: The one date that cannot be moved.
ui.anbud.ny.verdi_hjelp: Optional. An empty field means «not stated», not «free».
ui.anbud.oversikt.hvorfor: The module submits no bids. A submitted bid is binding, and the deadline makes it irreversible — you cannot withdraw it and send a better one afterwards.
ui.anbud.profil.frist_hjelp: How many days before the deadline a tender without a ready draft becomes a finding.
ui.anbud.profil.geografi_hjelp: Comma separated: counties, municipalities or countries.
ui.anbud.profil.kilde_gyldig_hjelp: Used for documents without their own expiry date.
ui.anbud.profil.nace_hjelp: Comma separated. An empty list is not allowed — it would hide every tender.
ui.anbud.punkt.hvorfor: A fact is a QUOTATION from a source document, not a paraphrase. There is no way to write a claim without a source.
ui.anbud.punkt.ingen_gyldige_kilder: No valid source documents. Register one before the requirement can be covered.
ui.anbud.punkt.kilde_hjelp: Only documents valid now. An expired certificate is not documentation.
ui.anbud.punkt.sitat_hjelp: Verbatim from the document. At least four characters.

ui.ehf.klar_hjelp: «Ready for signature» is a state on our side. Nothing is sent, and the signature itself does not exist in this version.
ui.ehf.krav.avvik_hjelp: How long a document may sit unvalidated before the sweep reports it.
ui.ehf.krav.hvorfor: The thresholds are the tenant's: how early an expiry is announced, and how long a document may sit unvalidated.
ui.ehf.krav.utlop_hjelp: How many days before a rule set expires we start reporting it. A set that expires tomorrow and that nobody has replaced is a module that stops working overnight.
ui.ehf.krav_i_kodeliste: Must be in the code list
ui.ehf.krav_ikke_tom: The field must not be empty
ui.ehf.oversikt.hvorfor: This module checks the invoice's FORM against the standard, not its content. It sends no invoice and signs nothing: the correction is prepared here, and sending is decided by a human.
ui.ehf.regel.alvorlighet_hjelp: A warning stops nothing; an error makes the document invalid. The distinction is the standard's, not ours.
ui.ehf.regel.hvorfor: The rule language is small on purpose: four requirements and no free XPath. A rule you must run to understand is not a rule set — it is a program with a rule set's name.
ui.ehf.regel.kode_hjelp: The standard's own code, for example BR-CO-10.
ui.ehf.regel.kodeverdi_hjelp: Comma separated, and only for «must be in the code list». A code list rule with no list would be silently green.
ui.ehf.regel.krav_hjelp: Each option can be checked by reading the rule on its own.
ui.ehf.regel.sti_hjelp: Matches the parsed field literally. No patterns, no wildcards.
ui.ehf.regel.sumsti_hjelp: Only for «must equal the sum of». The sum is computed in whole minor units.
ui.ehf.regelsett.hvorfor: The rule belongs to the authority, and it changes. An ALREADY EXPIRED set may be registered on purpose: the module exists to answer what the standard said back then. What is not allowed is to judge by an expired set.
ui.ehf.regelsett.ingen: No rule sets registered. Without one, nothing can be validated.
ui.ehf.regelsett.sum_hjelp: The hash of the rule document as it was read. Without it, nobody can later say which text the version number pointed at.
ui.ehf.regelsett.til_hjelp: Leave blank if the set is still in force. Blank means «still in force», not «in force forever».
ui.ehf.regelsett.versjon_hjelp: The standard's own version label. Versioning belongs to the authority, not to us.
ui.ehf.regler.ingen: The rule set has no rules. Validating against it would report «no errors» about a document nobody looked at.
ui.ehf.retting.avvik_hjelp: Only defects that were judged, and that do not already have a correction.
ui.ehf.retting.begrunnelse_hjelp: Changing an invoice without a reason anyone can point to is changing a claim for payment.
ui.ehf.retting.hvorfor: The correction is prepared here and not sent. A defect without a basis cannot be corrected: a correction where we could not judge would change the invoice because we lacked data, not because anything was wrong.
ui.ehf.retting.til_hjelp: The from-value is taken from the defect — it is what actually appeared there.
ui.ehf.skjema.klar_ok: The correction is marked ready for signature. Nothing has been sent.
ui.ehf.skjema.retting_ok: The correction is prepared. Nothing has been sent.
ui.ehf.skjema.validert: {regler} rules: {feil} errors, {advarsler} warnings, {utenfor} without a basis.
ui.ehf.sluttdato.hvorfor: This exists because the rule belongs to the authority. A standards body announcing in June that the set is withdrawn on 31 December is exactly the change this module must follow. Everything else about the set is frozen.
ui.ehf.undertittel: The invoice's form against the standard — and which version of the standard the verdict was made under.
ui.ehf.uten_grunnlag_sum: {n} documents have rules with no basis to judge on.

ui.kampanje.oversikt.hvorfor: This module sends nothing. It exists in order to send — which is precisely why withholding that matters. An email cannot be recalled, and the remedy the template proposes for a wrongly sent campaign is to send another one. What happens here is that recipients, consent and campaigns are recorded, and the frequency cap is measured; a breach becomes a finding someone must look at.
ui.kampanje.sammendrag: {aktive} active recipients, {medsamtykke} with consent, {planlagte} planned campaigns. {funn} open findings.
ui.kampanje.skjema.aktiv_hjelp: A deactivated recipient is not added to new campaign plans, and the open findings are closed. An unsubscribe is always accepted — including from a deactivated recipient. The consent history remains.
ui.kampanje.skjema.aktiv_ok: The recipient's status has been changed.
ui.kampanje.skjema.avmelding_hjelp: Must be an https address. Not http: an unsubscribe link over an unencrypted connection leaks that the recipient got the campaign. A campaign without a link cannot be registered.
ui.kampanje.skjema.formal_hjelp: What the recipient was shown when they consented. Without it, “consent to what” is unanswered.
ui.kampanje.skjema.inntruffet_hjelp: The date the event happened. It cannot lie in the future.
ui.kampanje.skjema.kampanje_hjelp: Records that the recipient was meant to get the campaign. Nothing is sent; this is what the frequency cap is measured on.
ui.kampanje.skjema.kanal_hjelp: Where the consent came from. A checkbox at checkout and an imported list are not the same basis — and an imported list is often not consent at all.
ui.kampanje.skjema.kontakt_hjelp: The email address or number. It is never stored in clear text — the register keeps only a mask and a salted hash, enough to recognise and not enough to send to.
ui.kampanje.skjema.plan_ok: The recipient has been added to the campaign plan.
ui.kampanje.skjema.planlagt_hjelp: The date the campaign is meant to go out. This is the date the frequency cap is measured on — nothing is sent when it passes.
ui.kampanje.skjema.ref_hjelp: Your own customer or subscriber reference. It must be unique.
ui.kampanje.skjema.samtykke_ok: The consent event has been recorded.
ui.kampanje.skjema.tilstand_hjelp: An unsubscribe is recorded as “Withdrawn” — it is an event you record, not a row you delete. The history is the answer to whether we were allowed that day.
ui.kampanje.undertittel: Consent and frequency cap — not a send queue

ui.kontovakt.oversikt.hvorfor: Fraud is revealed by the history, not by what stands there now. That is why nothing is overwritten: a new account is a new line, and the previous one remains. The account number is never stored — only the last four digits and a salted hash.

ui.kontovakt.skjema.kanal_hjelp: How the account came in. It is the first question in any investigation of invoice fraud.
ui.kontovakt.skjema.kontonummer_hjelp: The number is never stored. The register computes the last four digits and a salted hash and discards the rest — it needs to detect changes, not to pay. The field is cleared once the line is recorded.
ui.kontovakt.skjema.metode_hjelp: Calling a number you already had is the only method that cannot be forged by whoever sent the invoice.
ui.kontovakt.skjema.oppgitt_av_hjelp: Who at the other party stated the account. That is exactly the detail that matters when an invoice came from a hijacked mailbox.
ui.kontovakt.skjema.ref_hjelp: Your own reference to the party, for example the supplier number. It is frozen after registration.
ui.kontovakt.skjema.ver_notat_hjelp: A verification without a note is a ticked box, and a ticked box is not a control.
ui.kontovakt.skjema.verifisert_av_hjelp: The person on our side who actually checked. Whoever stated the account cannot verify it — if they are the same, nothing was verified.

ui.kontovakt.terskel.reverifikasjon_hjel: A verification from 2019 says nothing about the account that stands there today.

ui.kontovakt.terskel.uverifisert_hjelp: An account nobody has checked is an account nobody has checked — even when it was never changed.
ui.kontovakt.undertittel: Who stated which account number, when and through which channel — and how a person verified it. The register stops no payment.

ui.lager.feil.tilstand: The register refused: stock would have gone negative, the point is written backwards, or the line is frozen.

ui.lager.ingen_terskler: No limits are set — the sweep cannot measure anything until they are.

ui.lager.merke_under_punkt: At or below the reorder point
ui.lager.oversikt.hvorfor: Stock is not a field anybody sets — it is the sum of the movements. That is why the ledger can always answer why exactly this many are left, and why a stock count also writes a line.
ui.lager.sammendrag: {aktive} active items, {medpunkt} with a reorder point, {underpunkt} at or below it. {funn} open findings.
ui.lager.skjema.aktiv_hjelp: An item is deactivated, never deleted: a deleted item would take the movement history with it, and that history is the entire stock level. Open findings are closed when the item is deactivated.
ui.lager.skjema.antall_hjelp: A whole number of units, always positive. The sign follows from the type: receipts and returns increase stock, issues and shrinkage reduce it.
ui.lager.skjema.begrunnelse_hjelp: A reorder point without a reason is a decision nobody can review — and it is the point that decides when someone is asked to spend money.
ui.lager.skjema.enhet_hjelp: The item's smallest unit («pcs», «metre», «gram»). Quantities are counted in whole such units, and the unit cannot be changed later — the whole history would then be numbers without a unit of measure.
ui.lager.skjema.gyldig_fra_hjelp: The date in the form YYYY-MM-DD. The previous point is closed the day before, and a point is never written backwards.
ui.lager.skjema.kode_hjelp: Your own item code. It is frozen after registration — an issue that cited the code must still find it.
ui.lager.skjema.kost_hjelp: Optional, and only a fact about this line. The register computes no inventory value — that requires a costing principle, and that is an accounting decision.
ui.lager.skjema.notat_hjelp: What happened. Shrinkage without a note is a number nobody can act on.
ui.lager.skjema.punkt_hjelp: The quantity at which someone should reorder. Zero is valid and means «we hold no stock of this» — that is different from having no point at all.
ui.lager.skjema.talt_hjelp: The quantity you actually counted. The register sets no stock level — it writes the difference between counted and recorded as a line, so the ledger still explains the number.
ui.lager.skjema.utfort_hjelp: The date something actually happened, not the date you got around to entering it.
ui.lager.terskel.caption: The tenant's own limits for the inventory findings
ui.lager.terskel.punkt: Days without a reorder point before a finding
ui.lager.terskel.punkt_hjelp: Without a point, «at or below the reorder point» can never become true for the item — and the absence of a finding then looks like everything is fine.
ui.lager.terskel.stille: Days without movement before a finding
ui.lager.terskel.stille_hjelp: Dead stock is tied-up capital, and nobody sees it unless someone says so.
ui.lager.terskel.telle_hjelp: Stock nobody has counted is a claim, not a measurement.
ui.lager.undertittel: Stock as the sum of its movements. The register orders nothing and forecasts nothing — a reorder point that has been passed is a finding for a person to act on.

ui.leverandor.feil.tilstand: The register rejected this. A measurement must fall within the agreement's validity, an ended agreement takes no measurements, and two active agreements for the same supplier and service do not exist.
ui.leverandor.ingen_terskler: No thresholds are set — so nobody knows what «too expensive» or «too poor» means here.
ui.leverandor.liste.caption: Agreements, active first and those with most breaches on top
ui.leverandor.sammendrag: {avtaler} active agreements with {leverandorer} suppliers, agreed at {avtalt}. {brudd} agreements are in SLA breach, and {funn} findings are open.
ui.leverandor.skjema.avslutt_hjelp: Ending an agreement without saying why is the one action nobody can review later. Open findings about the agreement are closed at the same time.
ui.leverandor.skjema.ekstern_ref_hjelp: Organisation number, your customer number with the supplier, or whatever your business uses. The format is yours.
ui.leverandor.skjema.ingen_part: Register a supplier first — an agreement is always with someone.
ui.leverandor.skjema.levert_hjelp: The date must fall within the agreement's validity. A measurement against an agreement that did not apply that day is a number without a verdict.
ui.leverandor.skjema.sla_hjelp: Delivery time, response time and error rate are breached when the actual value is HIGHER than agreed. Uptime is breached when it is LOWER.
ui.leverandor.sla.caption: Agreements, measurements and breaches by what was agreed
ui.leverandor.terskel.bruddgrense: Breaches before the agreement is a finding
ui.leverandor.terskel.bruddgrense_hjelp: One late delivery is life; three is a pattern. The line between them is yours, not the module's.
ui.leverandor.terskel.caption: The limits this tenant measures agreements against
ui.leverandor.terskel.prisstigning: Price rise that is too much
ui.leverandor.terskel.prisstigning_hjelp: In percent above the agreed price. One decimal — 12.5 is stored as 125 per mille, and the comparison is done in whole numbers so a threshold that is «almost» passed does not exist.
ui.leverandor.terskel.stillhet: Silence before an agreement is a finding
ui.leverandor.terskel.stillhet_hjelp: An active agreement without a single measurement for that long is something we pay for without measuring — and it will never produce an SLA breach, however poor the delivery is.
ui.leverandor.undertittel: Agreements, measured deliveries and purchase prices. The register pays nothing and sets no price — it shows where the relationship has drifted, and a person decides what to do.

ui.likviditet.ingen_gyldig_modell: No rule model in force. New forecasts cannot be made.
ui.likviditet.ingen_iverksettelse: The module carries nothing out. A cancellation goes through the payment module's own path, by a human.
ui.likviditet.ingen_maalinger: No measurements yet — we do not know whether the paths hold.
ui.likviditet.krav_mangler: The limits are not set. Without the horizon there is no date to measure against.
ui.likviditet.maal_forklaring: Enter the actual balance at week's end. Whether the measurement landed inside the interval is computed from the band stored on the row — not from what you type here.
ui.likviditet.maalefrist_hjelp: The grace period exists because the bank takes a few days to post. It is not an excuse to skip it.
ui.likviditet.metode_hjelp: Write how the path is computed. A model nobody can read is a model nobody can call wrong.
ui.likviditet.modeller_tomt: No model registered. Without a model in force no forecast can be made.
ui.likviditet.ore_hjelp: In øre. A negative number is a negative balance.
ui.likviditet.post_hvorfor: The platform cannot price payroll: the payroll module measures hours, and no rate exists anywhere. The amount is therefore registered by a human, and the name stays on the row.
ui.likviditet.treffrate: {treff} of {av} measurements landed inside the interval.
ui.likviditet.umaalte_sum: {n} forecasts stand unmeasured past their horizon.
ui.likviditet.undertittel: The cash path with an interval, and every forecast measured against what actually happened. The module cancels nothing and pays nothing.
ui.likviditet.usikkerhet_hjelp: 1500 = 15 per cent. The band is computed from this; a point without uncertainty is an imprecise forecast that has lost the information about how imprecise it is.
ui.lisens.caption: Licences, sorted by when the decision is due
ui.lisens.dialog.begrunnelsehjelp: This does not cancel the licence with the vendor — it records that somebody has. Without a written reason the row is a mystery a year from now, when somebody asks why the tool is gone.
ui.lisens.dialog.fornyelsehjelp: The agreement continues for a new period. The register will warn again before the new date — it must fall after the one currently recorded.
ui.lisens.feil.begrunnelse_kreves: The reason cannot be empty: an ended licence without a reason is a cost that disappears without anyone knowing why.
ui.lisens.feil.dato_kreves: The renewal date cannot be empty: a renewal without a date is no period to warn about.
ui.lisens.feil.generell: The action did not go through. Try again.
ui.lisens.feil.tilstand: The register refuses this change — the licence has probably already ended, or the date falls before the one recorded. Refresh the list and see what it says.
ui.lisens.liste.ingen: No licences are registered. An empty register does not mean we pay for nothing — it means nobody has written down what we pay for.
ui.lisens.skjema.eierhjelp: A licence without an owner is a licence nobody manages. The owner must be an active member of the organisation, and is often not the person who bought it.
ui.lisens.skjema.fristhjelp: The number of days before renewal a cancellation must be submitted. The notice is counted from that date, not from the renewal: with 90 days' notice the decision is made for you 90 days before the agreement continues. Leave the field empty when the agreement has no notice period.
ui.lisens.skjema.kildehjelp: The reference to the agreement, order number or invoice the licence comes from. A licence without a source is a claim.
ui.lisens.skjema.kostnadhjelp: Leave the field empty if the amount is unknown. A zero here would be a claim that the licence is free.
ui.lisens.skjema.varselhjelp: Notices are queued 60, 30 and 7 days before the decision is due — one per point, not one per run.
ui.lisens.undertittel: What we pay for, who owns it, and when the decision has to be made. Notices are queued well before the cancellation deadline — not before the renewal.

ui.lonn.feil.tilstand: The register refused this. Time cannot be worked in the future, the same source reference can only be recorded once, a plan is never written backwards, and a deactivated employee accepts no new time entries.
ui.lonn.liste.caption: Employees with current work plan and recorded time
ui.lonn.liste.ingen: No employees have been registered yet.
ui.lonn.oversikt.hvorfor: This module pays nothing out and produces no payroll file. A payroll file is not a payment — it is a file, it looks harmless, it can “just be generated”, and it hits everyone at once. What happens here is that time is collected and measured against the work plan; overtime becomes a finding someone must look at, not a flag that is set and forgotten.
ui.lonn.sammendrag: {aktive} active, {medtimer} with recorded time, {medplan} with a work plan. {funn} open findings.
ui.lonn.skjema.aktiv_hjelp: A deactivated employee accepts no new time entries, and the open findings are closed. The recorded time remains.
ui.lonn.skjema.aktiv_ok: The employee's status has been changed.
ui.lonn.skjema.begrunnelse_hjelp: The plan decides what someone's hours are measured against. That decision must be reviewable.
ui.lonn.skjema.dato_hjelp: The day the work was done. It cannot lie in the future.
ui.lonn.skjema.gyldig_fra_hjelp: The new plan replaces the previous one from this date. A plan is never written backwards — time already measured against the old plan must not get a new answer after the fact.
ui.lonn.skjema.kilde_hjelp: Who recorded the time. Time the employee entered and time a manager corrected in are not the same basis.
ui.lonn.skjema.plan_ok: The work plan has been set.
ui.lonn.skjema.planlagt_hjelp: The hours agreed per working day. This is what recorded time is measured against.
ui.lonn.skjema.prosjektkode_hjelp: The code worked on. If it differs from the work plan's, the day becomes a finding.
ui.lonn.skjema.ref_hjelp: Your own reference for the employee. It must be unique.
ui.lonn.skjema.timer_hjelp: Entered in hours, stored as whole minutes. A mis-entered hour is corrected with a new row — pick the source “Correction” — never by editing the old one.
ui.lonn.terskel.avvik_hjelp: How far a day may differ from the plan before it becomes a finding. Measured in both directions.
ui.lonn.terskel.caption: The tenant's own limits
ui.lonn.terskel.dag_hjelp: Time beyond this in one day is overtime. A business on rotating shifts sets its own.
ui.lonn.terskel.uke_hjelp: Time beyond this in one week is overtime, even when no single day is long. Without it, seven six-hour days in a row would pass unnoticed.
ui.lonn.terskel.uten_plan_hjelp: How long time may stay without a plan to measure it against. Without a plan there is no comparison, and then the hours are not measured.
ui.lonn.terskel.vindu_hjelp: How far back overtime, deviations and wrong project codes are assessed. These three cannot be corrected — the time is recorded and stands — so without a window the findings could never be closed. A missing work plan is exempt: it can be fixed by recording a plan, and the finding stays until someone does.
ui.lonn.undertittel: Recorded time measured against the work plan — not a payroll run
ui.merkevare.feil.tilstand: That action is not legal in this state.
ui.merkevare.feil.vurdering: The assessment was rejected. Are the thresholds set, and is the finding open?
ui.merkevare.funn.bruksform_hjelp: A domain name and an ad headline are not the same matter in law, and the difference decides what reaction is possible at all.
ui.merkevare.funn.hvorfor: A finding cannot be registered without a preserved copy. A page that has changed or vanished by the time the matter is raised is no case at all.
ui.merkevare.funn.ingen: No findings registered for this mark.
ui.merkevare.funn.ingen_kopier: No preserved copies exist. Register the copy first — the finding cannot be saved without it.
ui.merkevare.funn.kontekst_hjelp: Where on the page, and in what use. «This looks similar» without saying where it appeared is not documentation.
ui.merkevare.funn.kopi_hjelp: The copy is the evidence. Without it the finding is worthless — and worse than no finding, because someone acts on it.
ui.merkevare.funn.motpart_hjelp: Leave blank if it is not known. Blank is an honest answer; a guess is not.
ui.merkevare.funn.observert_hjelp: Word for word as it appeared. Not corrected, not normalised — the database does the normalising, and both are stored.
ui.merkevare.henvis.hvorfor: The referral sends nothing. It attaches a pointer to a case in the exception queue, and a human decides from there. It can be set once.
ui.merkevare.henvis.unntak_hjelp: The id of the case in the exception queue.
ui.merkevare.ingen_terskel_varsel: No confusion threshold is set. How similar something must be before it counts as confusion is a legal judgement, not a constant — without it, nothing can be assessed.
ui.merkevare.kopi.hentet_hjelp: When the copy was actually taken. Not the same as when the row is written, and the difference can matter.
ui.merkevare.kopi.hvorfor: The module fetches nothing itself. The copy is registered by whoever captured it, with a content hash and a size — those bind the row to the bytes.
ui.merkevare.kopi.lagring_hjelp: Where the bytes live in the artefact store.
ui.merkevare.kopi.sum_hjelp: 64 hexadecimal characters. Without it the row could point at anything.
ui.merkevare.kopi.url_hjelp: http and https only. The address is shown as text, never as a link: the page does not invite an outgoing request.
ui.merkevare.krav.funnfrist_hjelp: How long an open finding may sit before the sweep reports it. Evidence goes stale.
ui.merkevare.krav.henvfrist_hjelp: How long a confusion above the threshold may sit unreferred.
ui.merkevare.krav.hvorfor: The thresholds are the tenant's. A trademark in a niche tolerates far less similarity than a generic word does, and the module does not own that judgement.
ui.merkevare.krav.terskel_hjelp: Similarity at or above this counts as confusion. The field stays empty until someone sets it — a pre-filled number would be a hardcoded threshold.
ui.merkevare.lukk.begrunnelse_hjelp: A finding that disappears without anyone writing why is a decision nobody can review.
ui.merkevare.lukk.nektes: The finding is assessed at {likhet}% similarity against a {terskel}% threshold and has not been referred. A finding above the tenant's own threshold is not closed here — it is referred, and a human decides.
ui.merkevare.merke.klasser_hjelp: Comma separated. The classification is the registrar's, not ours.
ui.merkevare.merke.nummer_hjelp: Number and registrar belong together: a registered trademark and an established sign do not enjoy the same protection.
ui.merkevare.oversikt.hvorfor: This module documents and reports. It never sends claims or complaints — every reaction is decided by a human, and the module's only exit is a referral to the exception queue.
ui.merkevare.skjema.funn_ok: The finding is registered with its preserved copy.
ui.merkevare.skjema.henvist: The finding is referred to the exception queue. A human decides from there.
ui.merkevare.skjema.vurdert: Assessed at {likhet}% against a {terskel}% threshold. Basis: {grunnlag}.
ui.merkevare.ubrukte_kopier: {n} preserved copies are not attached to a finding.
ui.merkevare.uhenviste_sum: {n} confusions are waiting for a human.
ui.merkevare.undertittel: The marks we watch, what has been found, and what the finding rests on.
ui.merkevare.uten_vurdering_varsel: The finding has not been assessed. An unassessed finding is not a harmless finding — it is one nobody has taken a position on.
ui.merkevare.varsler.lukk_hvorfor: «Confusion not referred» is not in the list and cannot be closed: that alert disappears when the finding is referred, not before.
ui.merkevare.varsler.notat_hjelp: What was done, or why the alert does not apply.
ui.merkevare.vurder_hjelp: The assessment is computed in the database and is deterministic: the same texts give the same number, today and in three years. The threshold is the tenant's own.
ui.modellstyring.ingen: No modules have golden sets or evaluation requirements yet.
ui.modellstyring.krav_ingen: No current requirement — the gate is not active for this module.
ui.modellstyring.undertittel: Golden sets, evaluation requirements and the model switch gate per module. The model card is a reading of the register — never a stored claim.
ui.mote.aksjonsfrist_hjelp: How long an action may stay past its deadline before it becomes a finding.
ui.mote.aksjonsgrunn_hjelp: Write why. The reason is recorded in the evidence chain with your name, and a closure cannot be undone.
ui.mote.begrunnelse_hjelp: Write why the finding is being closed. The reason is recorded in the evidence chain with your name.
ui.mote.beskrivelse_hjelp: Write out what the basis is. Whoever has to answer for the recording must be able to read why it was lawful, not look up a code.
ui.mote.beslutning_paa_ubekreftet: {n} decisions rest on a point the machine was unsure of.
ui.mote.deltakere_hjelp: Comma separated. The platform has no person register, so these are open references — the same form M-30 and M-50 use.
ui.mote.feil.generell: The action could not be completed.
ui.mote.feil.tilstand: The state has changed. Reload the page.
ui.mote.formal_hjelp: A basis without a purpose is a basis for anything, and that is not a basis.
ui.mote.grensene_er: Minutes deadline {referat} days, action deadline {aksjon} days, threshold {terskel}.
ui.mote.grunnlagstype_hjelp: Consent is one of four bases, and in an employment relationship often the weakest — the power imbalance makes it so. Choose the one that actually applies, not the easiest one.
ui.mote.gyldig_til_hjelp: Leave empty if the basis still applies.
ui.mote.hjemler_tomt: No recording bases are registered. Without a valid basis no recording can start.
ui.mote.hvorfor: M-7 gathers meeting preparation, minutes and actions. The module makes no decision — every decision carries the name of the person who made it. Recording never starts without legal basis and notification, and the notification must have happened before the microphone.
ui.mote.ingen_gyldig_hjemmel: No recording basis applies today. Register one first — a recording without a basis is unlawful the moment it starts.
ui.mote.krav_mangler: The tenant's limits are not set. Without a confidence threshold nothing can be marked unconfirmed.
ui.mote.opptak_forklaring: The door refuses if the basis is missing or expired, if nobody was notified, or if the notification came after the recording started. A refusal that comes after the microphone is not a refusal.
ui.mote.referat_tomt: No minute entries have been written for this meeting.
ui.mote.referatfrist_hjelp: How long after the meeting we require the minutes to exist. Minutes that arrive three weeks later are a reconstruction.
ui.mote.terskel_hjelp: An entry the machine is less confident about than this is marked unconfirmed. 7000 = 70%. What counts as low is a judgement about how much it costs to be wrong — a board meeting and a status round do not tolerate the same.
ui.mote.undertittel: The module makes no decision. It writes down the one people made, and marks what it is unsure of.
ui.mote.uten_referat_sum: {n} meetings have ended without anyone writing minutes.
ui.mote.varslede_hjelp: Comma separated. «Everyone was notified» is not a list.
ui.mote.varslet_hjelp: Must be before the recording started. A notification recorded afterwards is not a notification — it is an excuse.
ui.motpart.feil.generell: Something went wrong. Please try again.
ui.motpart.feil.tilstand: The action is not legal now — for example a lookup within the freshness window, or an answer that is already recorded.
ui.motpart.funn.notat_hjelp: At least four characters. A finding closed without reasoning is hidden, not resolved.
ui.motpart.ingen_krav: No policy set — neither the freshness window nor the cap can be measured.
ui.motpart.krav.ferskhet_hjelp: A new lookup for the same company number is refused within this window. 0 turns the window off.
ui.motpart.krav.tak_hjelp: A proposal above the cap is stored and becomes a finding — it is not rejected.
ui.motpart.krav.uvurdert_hjelp: How long a new counterparty may stay unassessed before it is a finding.
ui.motpart.ny.navn_hjelp: As you know the counterparty. The name the register returns is stored separately.
ui.motpart.oppslag.formaal_hjelp: Must be chosen. There is no preselected value.
ui.motpart.oppslag.hjemmel_hjelp: What gives you the right to ask. At least eight characters.
ui.motpart.oppslag.hvorfor: The lookup sends the company number outside the house. Purpose and legal basis are stored on the row and can be read back by you.
ui.motpart.oppslag.tittel: Look up in the company register
ui.motpart.oppslag.uten_krav: No policy set — a lookup requires a freshness window.
ui.motpart.oppslag.vindu: Freshness window: {timer} hours. A new lookup within the window is refused.
ui.motpart.oversikt.hvorfor: The module proposes a credit limit; it does not set one. Refusal is always a human decision.
ui.motpart.skjema.oppslag_ok: The lookup was performed and logged.
ui.motpart.tellinger: {motparter} counterparties, {aktive} active, {profil} with a profile, {vurderte} assessed.
ui.motpart.undertittel: Who we trade with, what the register says, and what we have asked.
ui.motpart.vurdering.begrunnelse_hjelp: At least eight characters. A number without reasoning is not an assessment.
ui.motpart.vurdering.hvorfor: A PROPOSAL, measured against the policy in force now. The module sets no credit limit.
ui.myndighet.bevis.dato_hjelp: The date the filing was actually made. Cannot be in the future — proof dated tomorrow is not proof, it is a plan.
ui.myndighet.bevis.hvorfor: This sends nothing. It records that a person HAS filed, somewhere else, and which receipt the authority gave. We have no channel to the authority.
ui.myndighet.bevis.kvittering_hjelp: The reference the authority gave. Without it the proof is a claim; with it, it is something that can be looked up with whoever received it.
ui.myndighet.bevis.person_hjelp: The person who made the filing — not the system, and not necessarily whoever records it here.
ui.myndighet.feil.tilstand: The action was refused. Either the warning period is missing, the rule set has been withdrawn, the date is in the future, or the finding can only be closed by the state going away.
ui.myndighet.funn.lukk_hvorfor: Only reminders can be closed by hand. A passed deadline, and an obligation resting on a withdrawn rule set, close when the state is gone — when someone actually files, or registers the obligation anew.
ui.myndighet.funn.notat_hjelp: At least four characters. The note is kept in the audit chain along with who closed the finding.
ui.myndighet.funn_plikt_utlopt: Obligation on a withdrawn rule set
ui.myndighet.hjemmel_utlopt: The legal basis has been withdrawn
ui.myndighet.ikke_sendt_passert: NOT FILED — the deadline has passed
ui.myndighet.ingen_gyldig_regelverk: No rule set is in force today. No new obligations can be registered.
ui.myndighet.ingen_varselfrist: No warning period is set. No deadlines are being watched, and new obligations cannot be registered.
ui.myndighet.krav.eskalering_hjelp: How long a warning may stand unhandled before it counts as more than a reminder.
ui.myndighet.krav.hvorfor: The periods are the tenant's own. A business with an accountant and a fourteen-day internal deadline needs a different warning than one doing it themselves the night before.
ui.myndighet.krav.regelvarsel_hjelp: How long before a rule set is withdrawn we say so. An outdated rule looks exactly like a correct one.
ui.myndighet.krav.varsel_hjelp: Without it there is no deadline to warn on, and new obligations cannot be registered.
ui.myndighet.oversikt.hvorfor: The module files nothing. A filing to an authority is binding and cannot be recalled — it is done by a person, at the authority, and recorded here afterwards with the receipt they were given.
ui.myndighet.passert_sum: {n} deadlines have passed with nothing filed.
ui.myndighet.plikt.frist_hjelp: The authority's deadline, as read — not calculated. It cannot fall before the period ends.
ui.myndighet.plikt.hvorfor: One concrete filing with one concrete deadline. The legal basis and rule version are written with the row, so «what were we required to do, by whom, under which rule» can be read years later.
ui.myndighet.plikt.ingen_gyldige: No rule set is in force today. Register a current rule set before registering obligations.
ui.myndighet.plikt.regelverk_hjelp: Only rule sets in force today can be chosen. A withdrawn rule set remains in the archive — it is the use that is closed, not the memory.
ui.myndighet.plikttype.frekvens_hjelp: A fact, not a calculation. The module does not derive the next deadline from it: deadlines belong to the authority, they move, and a calculated deadline would look just as certain as one that was read.
ui.myndighet.plikttype.hvorfor: The obligation type is what kind of filing it is — VAT return, payroll report, shareholder register. It is registered once; each period becomes its own obligation with its own deadline.
ui.myndighet.plikttype.nokkel_hjelp: Machine name: lower-case letters, digits and underscore, at least three characters. Used to recognise the type across periods.
ui.myndighet.regelverk.hjemmel_hjelp: The act, regulation or decision the obligation comes from. An obligation without a basis is a claim that someone must do something, without saying who decided it.
ui.myndighet.regelverk.hvorfor: A rule set that has already been withdrawn can be registered. The archive must be able to answer what the rule said THEN — an obligation from 2019 has to be understandable against the basis that applied in 2019. It is new OBLIGATIONS that cannot attach to a withdrawn rule set.
ui.myndighet.regelverk.ingen: No rule sets registered. Without one there is no legal basis to attach an obligation to.
ui.myndighet.regelverk.sha_hjelp: 64 hexadecimal characters. The hash binds the row to the text you actually read — if the rule set changes without the version changing, the hash is what reveals it.
ui.myndighet.regelverk.til_hjelp: Leave empty if no withdrawal has been announced. Empty is not the same as «does not apply».
ui.myndighet.regelverk.versjon_hjelp: The authority's own version label, verbatim. It is what decides whether two obligations rest on the same rule.
ui.myndighet.skjema.bevis_ok: Proof recorded. The system has not filed anything — this is the note that a person did.
ui.myndighet.skjema.krav_ok: Warning periods saved. Nothing has been filed.
ui.myndighet.skjema.plikt_ok: Obligation registered with its legal basis and deadline. Nothing has been filed.
ui.myndighet.sluttdato.dato_hjelp: Clear the field to say the rule set still applies. The date cannot precede the rule set's start date.
ui.myndighet.sluttdato.hvorfor: The rule set's identity is frozen. Only the withdrawal date can be set — an authority announcing that a form is being retired is precisely the change the module exists to watch for.
ui.myndighet.undertittel: Mandatory filings with deadlines, the legal basis they rest on, and who actually filed. The module sends nothing — it makes sure no deadline passes without a person having seen it.

ui.onboarding.feil.tilstand: The register rejected this. A step cannot be done before an earlier mandatory step, and a run is not completed until the mandatory steps are.
ui.onboarding.lop.caption: Onboarding runs, in progress first and oldest on top
ui.onboarding.maler.caption: Onboarding templates with step counts
ui.onboarding.maler.ingen: No templates registered. A run needs a template to take its steps from.
ui.onboarding.maler.laast: cannot be changed - {antall} runs in progress
ui.onboarding.sammendrag: {paagaende} runs in progress, {stoppede} stalled, {fullforte} completed and {avbrutte} cancelled. {maler} active templates.
ui.onboarding.skjema.avbryt_begrunnelse: Why is the run being cancelled?
ui.onboarding.skjema.avbryt_hjelp: 'We gave up' without a why is the one piece of information nobody can learn anything from later.
ui.onboarding.skjema.start_eierhjelp: The person answering for the run as a whole. The steps inherit the owner and can be moved one at a time afterwards.
ui.onboarding.skjema.steg_feil: Every line needs a name, a description and a number of days.
ui.onboarding.skjema.steg_jsonhjelp: One step per line: name | description | days until due - and "| V" at the end if the step is OPTIONAL. Without V the step is mandatory and blocks the ones after it. The whole set is saved at once and the template's version increases - runs in progress keep the form they were started on.
ui.onboarding.steg_ok: The step is marked as done.
ui.onboarding.undertittel: The runs for new customers: which steps they consist of, who owns each one, and where they actually stand. The register provisions nothing - it makes progress measurable.
ui.optimalisator.anslag_hjelp: The estimate is yours, in øre. The platform cannot price the effect of a measure, and a module that derived it would rank on a number it made up.
ui.optimalisator.avvikl_hjelp: Retirement is one-way. A retired version cannot be revived — otherwise «which model applied then?» would be unanswerable.
ui.optimalisator.avviklet_ok: The model version has been retired.
ui.optimalisator.baselinje_hjelp: The name of what the model is measured against, for example «no ranking». Without a named baseline, «was the ranking better than nothing?» is a question without a reference.
ui.optimalisator.begrunnelse_hjelp: Write why the finding is being closed. The reason is recorded in the evidence chain with your name.
ui.optimalisator.feil.generell: The action could not be completed.
ui.optimalisator.feil.tilstand: The state has changed. Reload the page.
ui.optimalisator.grunnlagstype_hjelp: What the proposal rests on. A correlation is not a cause, and a proposal that does not say what it rests on pretends to rest on something stronger than it does.
ui.optimalisator.gyldig_til_hjelp: Leave empty if the version still applies.
ui.optimalisator.horisont_hjelp: How long a measure is given to work before the effect is measured. A measure without a date it can be checked against is a proposal nobody can call wrong.
ui.optimalisator.hvorfor: M-36 reads the open findings from the platform's module registers and ranks measures a person has proposed. It carries nothing out, overrides no other module's limits, and cannot widen its own authority — execution goes through the module that owns the action, by a person.
ui.optimalisator.ingen_aa_avvikle: No valid model version to retire.
ui.optimalisator.ingen_gyldig_modell: No model version is valid today. Without a valid model no ranking can be produced.
ui.optimalisator.ingen_maalinger: No effect has been measured yet — we do not know whether the ranking is accurate.
ui.optimalisator.irreversible_sum: {n} irreversible measures have not been assessed.
ui.optimalisator.kilde_hjelp: Which module's finding register the signal came from. A proposal pointing at a register M-36 does not read cannot be traced back to a measurement — and the door refuses.
ui.optimalisator.krav_mangler: The tenant's limits are not set. Without a horizon there is no date to measure the effect against.
ui.optimalisator.maal_forklaring: Enter the effect actually achieved. The measurement cannot be corrected afterwards — it stands as given, with your name on it.
ui.optimalisator.maalefrist_hjelp: How long after the horizon we require the effect to be measured.
ui.optimalisator.maks_hjelp: How many measures a ranking includes. A list nobody has time to read is a list nobody acts on.
ui.optimalisator.metode_hjelp: Write out how the model ranks. This is something someone must be able to verify, not a choice from a dropdown.
ui.optimalisator.modell_lagret: The model version has been registered.
ui.optimalisator.modeller_tomt: No model is registered. Without a model no ranking can be produced.
ui.optimalisator.notat_hjelp: Write why. The note is recorded in the evidence chain with your name.
ui.optimalisator.opphevet_ok: The portfolio stop has been lifted.
ui.optimalisator.ore_hjelp: Whole øre. The field must be filled in: an empty field is not zero effect.
ui.optimalisator.rev_hjelp: A measure whose reversibility nobody has assessed is a measure nobody can undo — and those are exactly the ones that look cheapest.
ui.optimalisator.stopp_forklaring: The stop halts M-36, not the portfolio. While it is active no new rankings are produced — that is the only thing the module may lawfully halt, because halting another module would be overriding its limits. This is not an emergency brake for operations.
ui.optimalisator.stopp_hindrer: The portfolio stop is active. Lift it before a new ranking can be produced.
ui.optimalisator.stopp_paa: The portfolio stop is ON — no new rankings are produced.
ui.optimalisator.stoppet_ok: The portfolio stop has been set.
ui.optimalisator.stoppgrunn_hjelp: Write why. The reason is recorded in the evidence chain with your name, and a stop cannot be deleted — only lifted.
ui.optimalisator.treffrate: {treff} of {av} measured entries fell inside the interval.
ui.optimalisator.umaalte_sum: {n} ranking entries have passed their horizon without being measured.
ui.optimalisator.undertittel: Ranks measures and stops there. Nothing is carried out from here.
ui.optimalisator.usikkerhet_hjelp: The model's uncertainty in basis points (2000 = 20%). It is a property of the model, not of the estimate: two model versions can read the same number and have different confidence in it.
ui.optimalisator.vurder_om: A measure can be assessed or rejected. There is no third value: execution goes through the module that owns the action, by a person.
ui.oversikt.telling_note: A simple count for the day — not metrics over time.
ui.personvern.caption: Requests, sorted by current deadline
ui.personvern.dialog.avvishjelp: The data subject has the right to know why the request is not being acted on (art. 12(4)). Without a written reason a refusal would be a free way out of any deadline.
ui.personvern.dialog.forlenghjelp: Art. 12(3) grants two extra months against a reason, not on request. Write why the case is complex. The register refuses a date beyond the cap of three months from receipt.
ui.personvern.dialog.svarhjelp: A request is closed by a written response, never by the deadline passing. Write the reference to what was sent — archive number, case number or the receipt from the dispatch. The register erases nothing; execution happens where the store is owned.
ui.personvern.feil.begrunnelse_kreves: The reason cannot be empty: the data subject has the right to know why.
ui.personvern.feil.dato_kreves: The new deadline is missing a date.
ui.personvern.feil.generell: The action did not go through. Try again.
ui.personvern.feil.svar_kreves: The response reference cannot be empty: a request is closed by a written response, never by the deadline passing.
ui.personvern.feil.tilstand: The register refuses this change — the request is probably already answered or refused, or the new deadline lies beyond the statutory cap. Reload the list and see what it says.
ui.personvern.liste.ingen: No data subject requests are registered. An empty register does not mean no one has asked — it means no one wrote it down, and a request that is not here has no deadline anyone measures.
ui.personvern.skjema.eierhjelp: A request without an owner is a request no one answers. The owner must be an active member of the organisation, and is often someone other than the person registering it.
ui.personvern.skjema.lagrehjelp: Comma-separated store ids from the retention register. Without them the request becomes a finding at the next sweep: a request that does not say where it applies is one no one can verify the answer against.
ui.personvern.skjema.mottatthjelp: The register computes the deadline: one month from receipt (GDPR art. 12(3)). The date cannot be changed afterwards — it is the zero point the deadline is measured from.
ui.personvern.skjema.subjekt: Case reference for the data subject
ui.personvern.skjema.subjekthjelp: A REFERENCE, not a name or e-mail: case number, archive reference or ticket id. A register of those who have requested access is itself a store of personal data, and it must not become one more.
ui.personvern.undertittel: Access, rectification and erasure requests with deadline, owner and a written response. The register erases nothing — execution is done by whoever owns the store, and the register is what lets anyone see that it was done.

ui.prisbok.skjema.begrunnelse_hjelp: A price change without a reason is a decision nobody can review — and the price is what the business earns.
ui.prisbok.skjema.enhet_hjelp: What the price applies to: hour, item, month. Your word.
ui.prisbok.skjema.gyldig_fra_hjelp: The previous price is closed the day before. A price is never written backwards — «what stood here then» is the whole question the book exists to answer.

ui.prisbok.skjema.kode_hjelp: The code is frozen after registration — a quote that cited it must still find it.
ui.prisbok.skjema.pris_ok: The price is saved as a new version.
ui.prisbok.skjema.standard_hjelp: Standard clauses are the ones that must always be attached.

ui.prisbok.terskel.utenpris_hjelp: A product without a valid price is a product nobody can quote.

ui.prognose.gyldig_til_hjelp: Leave empty if the version still applies.
ui.prognose.horisont_hjelp: How many weeks ahead the forecast runs. This is the tenant's decision, not the module's.
ui.prognose.hvorfor: M-33 forecasts staffing demand from hours actually recorded, and measures itself against «same as last week». It hires no one, dismisses no one and moves no shift — a staffing decision goes through a separate policy-controlled path, made by a person.
ui.prognose.ingen_aa_avvikle: No valid model version to retire.

ui.prognose.krav_mangler: The tenant's forecast limits are not set. Without a horizon there is no date to measure against.
ui.prognose.maal_forklaring: Enter the minutes actually worked. The measurement cannot be corrected afterwards — it stands as given, with your name on it.
ui.prognose.maalefrist_hjelp: How long after a week has ended we require it to be measured. The grace period exists because timesheets are filled in afterwards — it is not an excuse to skip it.
ui.prognose.metode_hjelp: Write out how the model computes. This is something someone must be able to verify, not a choice from a dropdown.
ui.prognose.minutt_hjelp: Whole minutes. The field must be filled in: an empty field is not zero minutes.
ui.prognose.modell_lagret: The model version has been registered.
ui.prognose.modeller_tomt: No model is registered. Without a model no forecast can be produced.
ui.prognose.prognose_krever_historikk: The forecast is refused if no time is recorded in the basis window. Zero hours because nobody recorded any is not the same as zero work.

ui.prosjekt.feil.tilstand: The register rejected this. A milestone cannot be marked reached without a reference to what documents it, a reached milestone is frozen, and an ended project takes no more work.
ui.prosjekt.ingen_terskler: No limits are set — so nobody knows what «over budget» or «silent too long» means here.

ui.prosjekt.skjema.avslutt_hjelp: Open findings about the project are closed at the same time. Afterwards the project takes no more work.
ui.prosjekt.skjema.budsjett_hjelp: What the project may COST. Not what we can claim — that is in the payment plan, and the two are never mixed.
ui.prosjekt.skjema.dokumentasjon_hjelp: A report, a photo number, a signed handover. A milestone marked reached without a reference is a claim — and that claim is the basis for an invoice to the customer.
ui.prosjekt.skjema.plan_feil: Every line needs a name, a date in the form YYYY-MM-DD and an amount.
ui.prosjekt.skjema.plan_hjelp: One milestone per line: name | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | amount in kroner. The whole plan is saved in one go, and milestones already reached are left alone — they are the basis for a claim already made.
ui.prosjekt.skjema.timer_hjelp: Stored in whole minutes. «1.5 hours» becomes 90 minutes — an hour ledger in decimals shows itself first when the sums do not add up.
ui.prosjekt.terskel.budsjett_hjelp: In per mille above the budget. Zero means any overrun is a finding. The comparison is done in whole numbers so a limit that «almost» is passed does not exist.

ui.prosjekt.terskel.stillhet_hjelp: An active project without a single hour recorded for that long is either finished or forgotten — and those are different states with different actions.
ui.prosjekt.undertittel: The project, the contract's milestones and spend against budget. The register invoices nothing — an invoice for a milestone nobody documented is money claimed for work that may not have happened.

ui.telefoni.ingen_linjer: No lines recorded for this call.

ui.telefoni.opptak_forklaring: Notice must come before the recording starts. A refusal that arrives after the microphone is not a refusal.
ui.telefoni.regel_hjelp: At least 16 characters — the person woken up should be able to read why.
ui.telefoni.regel_om: The rules are the customer's. The module escalates only by a rule someone wrote.
ui.telefoni.regelvalg_hjelp: Only rules in force can be chosen. An escalation without a rule is the module's own decision.
ui.telefoni.samtale_forklaring: The agent must say what it is within {n} seconds of the call starting. Anyone who has talked longer than that has already answered as if to a person.
ui.telefoni.samtaletak_hjelp: A call left open longer than this is a recording that formally is still running.
