ui.tilgang.funn.ingen: No open findings. The list is filled by the review sweep, which runs once a day.
ui.tilgang.liste.ingen: No access has been registered yet. An empty register does not mean nobody has access — it means nobody has written down who does.
ui.tilgang.objektskjema.navnhjelp: What in the system the access applies to — a mailbox, a folder, a module.
ui.tilgang.objektskjema.systemhjelp: The name of the system as you call it, for example “Microsoft 365”. The same system must have the same name every time.
ui.tilgang.tilgangsskjema.eierhjelp: The person at your organisation who answers for this access existing. Must be an active member of the account — often someone other than the holder.
ui.tilgang.tilgangsskjema.gjennomganghje: How often the access must be re-examined. If the deadline passes without a recorded review, it becomes a finding.
ui.tilgang.tilgangsskjema.hjemmelhjelp: The role, decision or agreement the access follows from. An access nobody can justify is a finding even when it has an owner.
ui.tilgang.tilgangsskjema.objekthjelp: The object must be registered first. If you cannot find it in the list, register it above.
ui.tilgang.tilgangsskjema.subjekthjelp: The person or account as it is named in the system — usually an email address or an account name.
ui.tilgang.undertittel: Who has which access to what, with an owner and a legal basis. The register provisions nothing — it makes deviations visible.
ui.tilskudd.estimat.periode_hjelp: Source entries must overlap this period.
ui.tilskudd.feil.generell: Something went wrong. Please try again.
ui.tilskudd.feil.tilstand: The action is not legal now — for example a share larger than the source entry, a source entry outside the period, or an estimate already finalised.
ui.tilskudd.feil.uten_forutsetninger: The estimate cannot be finalised: it lacks line items or assumptions.
ui.tilskudd.ferdigstill_hjelp: «Ready for review» submits no application. It is a state on our side.
ui.tilskudd.forutsetning.hvorfor: What makes the estimate an estimate. Without at least one it cannot be finalised.
ui.tilskudd.forutsetning.konsekvens_hjel: «Falls away entirely» and «reduced by about 30%» are two very different messages. At least eight characters.
ui.tilskudd.forutsetning.tekst_hjelp: What the estimate rests on. At least eight characters.
ui.tilskudd.funn.notat_hjelp: At least four characters. An estimate above the scheme cap cannot be closed away.
ui.tilskudd.ingen_krav: No thresholds set — the uncertainty and deadlines are the tenant's.
ui.tilskudd.kildepost.hvorfor: Where the figures come from. Every amount in an estimate points at one of these — a figure without an origin cannot be checked.
ui.tilskudd.kildepost.ref_hjelp: The system's own: voucher number, payroll code, project code.
ui.tilskudd.kildepost.system_hjelp: Where the figure was taken from.
ui.tilskudd.kildepost.til_hjelp: The period must be over. A figure from the future is an estimate, not a source.
ui.tilskudd.krav.frist_hjelp: How many days before the deadline a scheme without a finalised estimate becomes a finding.
ui.tilskudd.krav.kilde_hjelp: An accounting figure from last year is not a basis for this year's application.
ui.tilskudd.krav.usikkerhet_hjelp: The range estimates are shown with. How cautious to be is a business decision.
ui.tilskudd.ny.hvorfor: The module fetches no scheme itself. A human has read the rules and states the version and content hash.
ui.tilskudd.ny.maks_hjelp: Optional. An empty field means «the scheme has no cap», not «the cap is zero».
ui.tilskudd.ny.regelverk_hjelp: Without it nobody can later say which rules the estimate was measured against.
ui.tilskudd.oversikt.hvorfor: The module submits no application, and the figures are ESTIMATES with assumptions — never promises. The range is shown with every figure.
ui.tilskudd.post.andel_hjelp: Cannot exceed the source entry's amount.
ui.tilskudd.post.begrunnelse_hjelp: Why exactly this share. At least four characters.
ui.tilskudd.post.hvorfor: The sum is the sum of the line items. There is no way to set an amount without a source entry.
ui.tilskudd.post.ingen_ferske_kilder: No fresh source entries. Register one before the estimate can be built.
ui.tilskudd.post.kilde_hjelp: Only source entries that are fresh enough. The amount is in brackets.
ui.tilskudd.skjema.ferdigstilt: The estimate is finalised: {sum} NOK, range {nedre} to {ovre}.
ui.tilskudd.sum_klare: {sum} across {n} finalised estimates — subject to assumptions.
ui.tilskudd.undertittel: The schemes we follow, what the estimates rest on, and how certain they are.
ui.tilskudd.uten_forutsetninger_varsel: The estimate has no assumptions and cannot be finalised. An estimate without assumptions is a promise.
ui.tollkode.feil.forslag_avvist: The proposal was rejected. Is the nomenclature in force, is the confidence above the threshold, and have these goods already been classified against this very nomenclature?
ui.tollkode.feil.klart_avvist: The proposal cannot be marked ready. Has the threshold been raised since it was issued, or has the nomenclature been withdrawn?
ui.tollkode.feil.tilstand: That action is not legal in this state.
ui.tollkode.forslag.art_hjelp: A binding tariff ruling weighs more than your own earlier classification, which weighs more than a textual likeness.
ui.tollkode.forslag.grunndato_hjelp: An earlier classification from last year weighs more than one from 2019.
ui.tollkode.forslag.henvisning_hjelp: Case number, commodity code or rule number — whatever makes the ground possible to look up. A ground nobody can look up is a claim.
ui.tollkode.forslag.hvorfor: A proposal without grounds is worse than no proposal: a code that sits there looks as finished as one somebody thought about. An empty field asks; a code without grounds answers. Add at least one ground before the proposal can be issued.
ui.tollkode.forslag.ingen_grunner: No grounds added yet. The proposal cannot be issued without at least one.
ui.tollkode.forslag.ingen_gyldige: No nomenclature in force has any headings. Register the current edition first.
ui.tollkode.forslag.nomenklatur_hjelp: Only nomenclatures in force with headings are offered. The number in brackets is how many commodity codes it has.
ui.tollkode.forslag.sikkerhet_hjelp: Your judgement, not the module's. Below the tenant's threshold the proposal is not issued — the goods stay unclassified, so somebody sees that they could not be classified.
ui.tollkode.forslag_over_en: {kode} — {sikkerhet}% confidence against a {terskel}% threshold, on one ground
ui.tollkode.forslag_under_en: {kode} — {sikkerhet}% confidence BELOW the {terskel}% threshold, on one ground
ui.tollkode.funn.lukk_hvorfor: «Code against a withdrawn nomenclature» is not in the list and cannot be closed: that finding disappears when the goods are classified again against one in force — that is an action, not an opinion.
ui.tollkode.funn.notat_hjelp: What was done, or why the finding does not apply.
ui.tollkode.funn_utlopt: Nomenclature withdrawn with no successor in force
ui.tollkode.ingen_gyldig_nomenklatur: No nomenclature in force. Without one, nothing can be classified.
ui.tollkode.ingen_terskel_varsel: No confidence threshold is set. How certain a classification must be before it is shown as a proposal is a risk judgement, not a constant — without it, nothing can be classified.
ui.tollkode.klart_hjelp: «Ready to declare» is a state on our side. Nothing is declared, and the declaration itself does not exist in this version.
ui.tollkode.kode_under_utlopt: The code rests on a withdrawn nomenclature
ui.tollkode.kode_under_utlopt_varsel: The code rests on a nomenclature that has since been withdrawn. Classify the goods again against one in force — a code against a withdrawn nomenclature is a well-formed and wrong answer.
ui.tollkode.krav.frist_hjelp: How long goods may sit unclassified before the sweep reports them.
ui.tollkode.krav.hvorfor: The thresholds are the tenant's. An importer with a thousand consignments a week and one with three do not have the same tolerance for being wrong.
ui.tollkode.krav.terskel_hjelp: A proposal below this is not issued. The field stays empty until someone sets it — a pre-filled number would be an authority the module granted itself over the customer's fines.
ui.tollkode.krav.utlop_hjelp: How many days before a nomenclature is withdrawn we start reporting it.
ui.tollkode.nomenklatur.hvorfor: The nomenclature belongs to the authority, and it is revised. An ALREADY WITHDRAWN edition may be registered on purpose: a classification from 2022 must be understandable against the nomenclature in force then. What is not allowed is classifying against a withdrawn edition.
ui.tollkode.nomenklatur.ingen: No nomenclature registered. Without one, nothing can be classified.
ui.tollkode.nomenklatur.sum_hjelp: The hash of the nomenclature as it was read. Without it, nobody can later say which text the version number pointed at.
ui.tollkode.nomenklatur.til_hjelp: Leave blank if the nomenclature is still in force. Blank means «still in force», not «in force forever».
ui.tollkode.nomenklatur.versjon_hjelp: The nomenclature's own version label, for example «HS 2022». Versioning belongs to the authority.
ui.tollkode.oversikt.hvorfor: This module proposes, and a proposal is not a declaration. An HS code is a legal claim about what the goods are, and the wrong code brings a fine — so every proposal carries what it rests on, and no code is issued without at least one ground.
ui.tollkode.skjema.forslag_ok: Proposal {kode} issued at {sikkerhet}% confidence against a {terskel}% threshold, on {grunner} grounds. Nothing has been declared.
ui.tollkode.skjema.forslag_ok_en: Proposal {kode} issued at {sikkerhet}% confidence against a {terskel}% threshold, on one ground. Nothing has been declared.
ui.tollkode.skjema.klart_ok: The proposal is marked ready to declare. Nothing has been declared.
ui.tollkode.sluttdato.hvorfor: This exists because the nomenclature belongs to the authority. A customs authority announcing in June that HS 2022 is withdrawn on 31 December is exactly the change this module must follow. Everything else about the nomenclature is frozen.
ui.tollkode.uklassifisert_varsel: The goods are not classified. Unclassified goods are not safe goods — they are cleared on guesswork the day they ship.
ui.tollkode.uklassifiserte_sum: {n} goods are not classified — they are cleared on guesswork the day they ship.
ui.tollkode.under_terskel_varsel: The proposal has {sikkerhet}% confidence, and the threshold is now {terskel}%. It cannot be marked ready.
ui.tollkode.under_utlopt_sum: {n} codes rest on a nomenclature that has since been withdrawn.
ui.tollkode.undertittel: Proposed HS code, what the proposal rests on, and which nomenclature it was made under.
ui.tollkode.vare.bruk_hjelp: What the goods are used for. A car part and a furniture part end up in different places.
ui.tollkode.vare.hvorfor: Material and use are their own fields because that is exactly what the nomenclature classifies on: a steel screw and a plastic one end up in different chapters.
ui.tollkode.vare.land_hjelp: Two letters (ISO 3166-1). It decides preferential duty, and is therefore part of what the error costs.
ui.tollkode.vare.materiale_hjelp: What the goods are made of.
ui.tollkode.varenummer.ingen: The nomenclature has no headings. Nothing can be classified against it.
ui.tollkode.varenummer.kode_hjelp: Four digits or more. The length belongs to the nomenclature — six for HS, eight for CN, ten for the national tariff.
ui.tollkode.varenummer.sats_hjelp: Hundredths of a percent, as an integer: 4500 is 45.00%. Leave blank if the rate is not registered — blank is not the same as duty free.
ui.tollkode.varenummer.tekst_hjelp: Word for word from the nomenclature. This is what a classification is argued against — the code is only an address.

ui.transport.funn_uten_landregel: Dangerous goods without a country rule
ui.transport.hjelp_adresse: The recipient's address version from the address module. The module reads the country from it — never the street — and requires the address to be checked and approved.
ui.transport.hjelp_avsenderland: Two capital letters, for example NO. The country must have a country package.
ui.transport.hjelp_begrunnelse: Why this plan. Read by a human.
ui.transport.hjelp_fareklasse: ADR's nine classes plus «not dangerous». The set is the international standard and is complete — which is why there is no «other».
ui.transport.hjelp_frist: How long a plan may stand without anyone acting on it.
ui.transport.hjelp_grunn: What was done, or why the case is over.
ui.transport.hjelp_maks: Above this it is freight, and that is a different conversation than a parcel.
ui.transport.hjelp_manuell: Above this weight a human should look at the plan regardless.
ui.transport.hjelp_oppgittav: The name of whoever looked at the parcel. They are the one who answers if it catches fire.
ui.transport.hjelp_vekt: Whole grams. Floating point and physical measurements do not belong together when someone loads a truck by them.
ui.transport.hvorfor: The module books no transport and rebooks nothing. It plans against parcels a human has measured and addresses someone has checked — and the hazard class is always given by a person, never inferred from a description.
ui.transport.kolli_hjelp: You measure the parcel and give the hazard class. The module never infers it from a description: a wrong claim about dangerous goods is a fire in a truck, not an error in a report.
ui.transport.kolli_uten_krav: Set the limits first. Without a sending country nothing can be measured against a country package.
ui.transport.krav_hjelp: The sending country must have a country package — without read rules for the country you ship from, nothing is verifiable. The version is assigned automatically, and the row is never changed: plans point to it.
ui.transport.plan_forkastet: The plan is discarded. It remains, and the parcel can get a new one.
ui.transport.plan_hjelp: You supply a parcel and an address version. The receiving country is read from the address, which must have an approved check — and the country must have a country package.
ui.transport.plan_uten_kolli: Every registered parcel already has an open plan. Register a new parcel, or discard a plan.

ui.transport.undertittel: Plans shipments against measured parcels and validated addresses. The module books no transport.

The receipt arrived after you rejected the case — when the execution itself happened is not known to the system; it may already have been under way before the rejection reached the module. ui.unntak.saksarsak.reversibilitet_ukjen: The task was performed. The receipt arrived after you rejected the case — when the execution itself happened is not known to the system; it may already have been under way before the rejection reached the module. The task ran without a registered module contract, so the system has no basis for saying whether the effect can be reversed. Someone has to find out what actually happened.
